prerequisites: Attendance and knowledge acquisition transmitted in the curricular unit of Fundamentals of Circuits and Electronics.
Domain of mathematical tools transmitted in the curricular units of Algebra, Mathematical Analysis I and II.

learning_outcomes.text: Learning of concepts and techniques of analysis of electrical circuits.

Consolidate the knowledge acquired in the unit of Fundamentals of Circuits and Electronics, concerning the use of basic tools of linear circuits analysis, essential for the success in other units that depend on this ability.
Increase student’s capability of electrical circuits analysis and additionally increase their aptitude for projecting and dimensioning simple circuits.

syllabus_topics: Electrical Circuits topology and circuits analysis techniques in continuous current.
Natural and Step response of RL, RC and RLC circuits (serial and parallel connected), as well as other second order circuit types.
Power Factor and Power Factor compensation.
teaching_methods: Application problems solved with/by the students
assessment_rules: Students can choose between two evaluation systems: (1) distributed evaluation, composed of four tests; (2) or evaluation based only on one exam. For both systems, all tests and exams are written evaluations.
bibliography: Jaime Batista dos Santos (2016)- ANÁLISE DE CIRCUITOS ELÉTRICOS, Publindústria, Porto, 2016.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
